*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}body{margin:0;background:var(--cp-bg);color:var(--cp-ink);font-family:var(--cp-font);line-height:1.65;font-size:16px;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility}img{max-width:100%;display:block}a{color:inherit}h1,h2,h3{line-height:1.18;margin:0;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em}p{margin:0}.cp-block{min-width:0}.cp-wrap{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px}.cp-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;white-space:nowrap;flex:none;height:44px;padding:0 20px;border-radius:var(--cp-radius);font:inherit;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.005em;text-decoration:none;border:1px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .16s,box-shadow .16s,background .16s,border-color .16s,opacity .16s}.cp-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}.cp-btn:active{transform:none}.cp-btn-primary{background:var(--cp-primary);color:var(--cp-on-primary,#fff);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.12),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.1)}.cp-btn-primary:hover{box-shadow:0 6px 18px color-mix(in srgb,var(--cp-primary) 28%,transparent)}.cp-btn-outline{background:var(--cp-bg);color:var(--cp-ink);border-color:var(--cp-line)}.cp-btn-outline:hover{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--cp-ink) 40%,var(--cp-bg))}.cp-btn-soft{background:var(--cp-soft);color:var(--cp-ink)}.cp-btn-soft:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--cp-soft) 82%,var(--cp-ink))}.cp-input{width:100%;height:46px;padding:0 15px;border:1px solid var(--cp-line);border-radius:var(--cp-radius);font:inherit;font-size:15px;background:var(--cp-bg);color:var(--cp-ink);outline:none;transition:border-color .16s,box-shadow .16s}textarea.cp-input{height:auto;padding:12px 15px;resize:vertical;line-height:1.6}.cp-input::placeholder{color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--cp-ink) 45%,var(--cp-bg))}.cp-input:focus{border-color:var(--cp-primary);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb,var(--cp-primary) 13%,transparent)}.cp-kicker{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--cp-ink) 62%,var(--cp-bg));margin-bottom:14px}

items.name: 倒计时
items.js: document.querySelectorAll('[data-cp-to]').forEach(function(box){var out=box.querySelector('strong');function tick(){var left=new Date(box.dataset.cpTo)-new Date();if(isNaN(left)){out.textContent='日期写错了';return;}if(left<0)left=0;var s=Math.floor(left/1000);out.textContent=Math.floor(s/86400)+' 天 '+Math.floor(s%86400/3600)+' 时 '+Math.floor(s%3600/60)+' 分 '+(s%60)+' 秒';}tick();setInterval(tick,1000);});
